verdict.wrong_value: Accessing Parameter.value when the internal _value is None raises an exception instead of returning NaN (np.isnan(param.value) should be True).
verdict.rationale: The bug is mishandling of the unset/null parameter state: an unset internal _value (None) should be represented as the special floating value NaN so numeric consumers (e.g. np.isnan) and repr work, rather than raising. This is null/special-value handling rather than a pure crash, though the evidence does not record a specific wrong numeric output beyond the raised exception.
